reason: The hypothesis directly restates the central findings and proposed mechanisms from P7/P14/P9 (and corroborated by P6/P31) that LCO governs strength and deformation pathways in NiCoCr, and proposes the same intervention (varying annealing to tune LCO) and predicted outcomes already demonstrated in those papers. The falsification test, while not explicitly performed in the passages, is an obvious experimental design that follows directly from the stated claims and does not add a new conceptual element.
